activity.notes: Jerome reached Bethlehem in 386 and settled into monastic scholarship. The date represents his documented personal relocation and settlement; it does not claim the Latin Vulgate was completed in 386. This is Jerome of Stridon (Saint Jerome), not Hieronymus of Syracuse, Hieronymus Wolf, or the Blue Archive fictional boss.

sources.title: St. Jerome — Catholic Encyclopedia (New Advent)
sources.citation_text: The Catholic Encyclopedia gives Jerome's arrival and settlement in Bethlehem in 386 and death in 420.

sources.title: St. Eustochium Julia — Catholic Encyclopedia
sources.citation_text: The contemporaneous associates Paula and Eustochium and Jerome settled in Bethlehem in 386, with the associated monasteries being established during 386–389.
